decisions.reason: It fits very closely with our core data, calculation and energy-sales know-how, remains prominently marketed in 2024, and our in-house R&D gives us strong capacity to refine it commercially.

Although its reduced website prominence suggests weaker standalone traction or integration into the platform, it is still closely related to our existing tariff and market-data capabilities, so we would more likely retain and adapt it than withdraw it.

As a tool that builds on our established platform and process knowledge, it likely supports broader customer workflows even if no longer heavily promoted, which makes continued integration and incremental improvement more attractive than dropping it.
